summary: RangeSlider's ROOT now carries data-slot="range-slider", matching Slider (ADR 0022); the header row that held that slot name is data-slot="range-slider-header". Kept parallel with Slider so the two controls cannot be targeted differently.

migration.manual: A selector or test that targeted the header row by [data-slot="range-slider"] now targets [data-slot="range-slider-header"]; [data-slot="range-slider"] now matches the whole control.
